scope: Bounded Tip window label/button and CLanguage folder static verification

MSI_DIDYOUKNOW.pe_evidence: HighPriest.exe VA 0x48202C pushes 0xAF before MsgStr call VA 0x514350; same label use is Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:30647-30648 (and navigation refill 13970-13971)

MSI_SHOWTIPSATSTARTUP.pe_evidence: HighPriest.exe VA 0x481F4E pushes 0xB0 before MsgStr call VA 0x514350; repeated at 0x481F69; source Ref/UIFrameWnd2.cpp:30623-30627

bitmap_evidence.selected_pe: HighPriest.exe OnCreate VA 0x481C05-0x481C55 points to bitmap stem strings at VA 0x6F3324-0x6F3360 and 0x6F410C/0x6F4424/0x6F4430, concatenated with .bmp at VA 0x6F1F2C
bitmap_evidence.dimensions_source: Recovered GRF assets under Ref/GRF-Content/data/texture/<user-interface>/; BMP headers. Base BMPs are 8-bit, states _a/_b are 8-bit.
bitmap_evidence.state_semantics: UIBitmapButton::OnDraw uses m_normalBitmapName for state 0, m_mouseonBitmapName for state 1, m_pressedBitmapName for state 2 (Ref/UIControl.cpp:5116-5147); SetBitmapName receives indices 0,1,2 (Ref/UIControl.cpp:8775 onward).

textviewer.finding: For message 29, UITextViewer defaults nonzero val2 to the line limit and calls CutStringWithColor(..., maxNumCharLine, val3 != 0). The Tip caller supplies val2=38 and val3=0, so this is color-aware wrapping with maxNumCharLine=38 and readCR=false; 38 is not a style enum.

language_folders.pe_constructor: HighPriest.exe CLanguage::CLanguage VA 0x4FDF30 calls GetUserDefaultLangID through import thunk at VA 0x4FE086 and masks low 10 bits at 0x4FE08C. String references: default English VA 0x6F756C; German 0x6F7578; Turkish 0x6F7580; Portuguese 0x6F758C; Italian 0x6F7598.
language_folders.lookup: LanguageFile prepends the selected folder for non-Korea; for .txt/.xml it checks file existence and falls back to the bare filename if absent (Ref/Language.cpp:1954-1974).

limits: No reliable button dimensions were inferred from window layout; all six-plus-three bitmap dimensions above are from recovered BMP headers.
Names and folder bytes were checked statically in the selected executable; no executable was run.
